question: For identical historical genotypes and identical future visitor histories, is the full-donor versus bounded-mean-target 80-generation occupancy residual robust across demographic random-stream realizations, or dominated by conditional stochastic recruitment?
basis: Existing independent16 allele mean/distribution donor experiment 35100801-35100816 reported near-identical first-generation viable output but history-dependent postshock occupancy differences. One postshock demographic realization per history is insufficient to assign the residual to variance, linkage or drift.
scope: The FIRST FOUR visitor histories of the previously exposed independent16 cohort, deterministically chosen by seed order, not by favourable observed results. EXPLORATORY technical repeatability, no independent-history confirmation.
randomization: First 400 updates and eight-individual bottleneck use the frozen 16-history biology and repeat 35101801. For post stress, each random replicate gets a distinct deterministic SeedSequence([history,35101801,setting_idx,post_idx,budget_idx,713,repeat_id,20261008]); seed independent of historical background and treatment. Matched full donor and mean-target treatments receive identical visitor sequence and poststress streams. No immigration.
outcomes: First-generation viable maternal output (identical across demographic repeats for fixed genotype)
Terminal occupancy and first extinction time for each demographic repeat
Paired full-donor minus mean-target occupancy difference within identical setting/history/background/post/budget/repeat
Within-history standard deviation of paired difference and across post-repeat mean
interpretive_guards: The old 16-history target comparison pre-registered failure remains FAILED.
This is same 4 histories from exposed source, so do not bootstrap 8 new demographic repeats as 8 independent ecological histories.
Same demographic streams are common random numbers; this is still not a pure variance effect or proof of no genomic influence.
The two genotypes differ in their allele variance and covariance and potentially fixed-rank assignments.
Different postshock replicates reveal conditional demographic uncertainty only; additional independent visitor histories would be needed for ecological generality.
Do not tune budgets or narrow to one setting after outcomes.
